summary: The three-file source migration does not provide a faithful supported setup route. It attempts to reconstruct a semantic-born empty closure with a source-bound emitter, but the required authored shot item membership is provider-managed and cannot be created by the registered commands or doc.patch.
blocking_findings: F1: occurrence_media.py:113-120 removes the explicit parent occurrences list used by the original setup before emitting commands, so the setup target is not the original authored input shape; a top-level parent occurrences change is a managed closure operation.

F2: occurrence_media.py:131-140 asks emit_document_commands to change the semantic-born shot from items=[] to the authored item-1 payload. The registered closure/item guard rejects that correspondence change; occurrence.create, shot.set, occurrence.add-media and placement commands do not create the original authored shot item.

F3: the changed callers in shared_auto_placement.py:17-20,44 and shot_pool.py:57,128 route their 16 protected nodes through the same unsupported helper, so the seam is cohort-wide for this partition even though the original test bodies are conserved.
unverified: No original integration node was run. The historical targeted request ended at conftest ImportError: ModuleNotFoundError: runtime_protocol before any intended node; it receives zero behavior credit.
